volunteerExperiences.description: Created an interactive mental health application that suggested therapeutic activities for clients between counseling sessions.

Removed a broken flagpole and several overgrown bushes at Saint Joseph School. Coordinated the purchasing and installation of a new flagpole, mulched a large area, and planted flowers. Installed a light fixture to shine on the American flag at night and filled in a new gravel pathway.

projects.title: TroveSpace
projects.description: Designed a social network for people to manage their collections and interact with other collectors. Worked on all aspects of the app from the Firebase database to the AngularJS user interface and search functionality. Users could manage multiple different collections using crowdsourced data.

projects.title: StockMock
projects.description: Developed a stock market simulator app to teach users how to invest and keep track of earnings. Worked on automated testing as well as the Firebase database functionality using AngularJS. Users could practice buying and selling shares, making bank transfers, and viewing their transaction history.
